The Sr Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that a product or feature is developed with a focus on delivering value to the customer and the business. They act as a voice for the customer and are responsible for making key product-related decisions throughout the development process, including identifying opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies, such as AI-enabled capabilities, where they can improve user experience, workflow efficiency, and business outcomes.

Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment
Translation: Work with stakeholders to translate future vision and requirements into clearly broken-down epics and stories; ensure all team members understand and align with product goals, including consideration of emerging technologies where appropriate.
Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary point of contact between the development team and stakeholders; communicate progress, changes, and updates regularly.
Team Enabler: Work with one or more Agile Development Teams and act as a central reference and information source, guiding system/product functionality decisions.
Entrepreneurial Spirit: Demonstrate a track record of delivering results in fast-moving, demanding environments.
Backlog Ownership & Prioritization
Prioritization: Create and maintain the product backlog; prioritize features, user stories, and tasks based on business value, customer needs, market trends, and strategic opportunities.
Backlog Management: Continuously groom and refine the backlog based on feedback, changing priorities, and new insights.
Feedback Integration: Gather and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and end-users into the backlog; adjust as necessary.

User Story Development: Break down high-level requirements into detailed, implementable user stories that meet strong Agile standards and support effective workflows, automation, and decision support where applicable.
Acceptance Criteria: Define clear acceptance criteria so the team understands what constitutes “done” for each feature.
UI/UX Alignment: Partner with UX to ensure backlog items have wireframes and UI designs ready for sprint planning; provide design feedback, participate in design sprints, and support user acceptance testing.
Planning, Delivery & Risk
Sprint Planning: Participate in sprint planning to select stories and tasks; ensure the team has a clear understanding of work scope.
Release Planning: Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to plan and prioritize releases aligned with market needs and business goals.
Quality Assurance: Ensure the product meets quality standards by accepting or rejecting work during sprint reviews.
Risk Management: Identify and mitigate delivery risks; partner with the release manager on timelines, tough conversations, mitigation strategies, and transparent escalation to leadership.
Business Outcomes & Data
Business Case Support: Assist in developing and presenting business cases for new features and initiatives; ensure alignment with strategic goals and stakeholder expectations.
Data-Driven: Define KPIs and measures for features and capabilities to track impact and inform decisions.

Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
4-7 years of relevant work experience
Experience with Product and Development tools such as ADO, Jira or other similar tools.
Healthcare and technical expertise are highly preferred, including experience with data, API integrations, and interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and assess opportunities related to emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, where applicable.
Leadership and decision-making skills
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Understanding of the industry, market trends, and customer needs

Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, UI/UX, Product Management, leadership, and internal and external stakeholders.

About Provation
Provation is a leading provider of healthcare software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, care coordination, quality reporting, and billing. Our purpose is to empower providers to deliver quality healthcare for all.

Provation’s comprehensive portfolio spans the entire patient encounter, from pre-procedure through post-procedure, with solutions for physician and nursing documentation (Provation® MD, Provation® Apex, MD-Reports, Provation® endoPRO®, and Provation® MultiCaregiver), anesthesia documentation (#1 Best in KLAS Provation® iPro), patient engagement, surgical care coordination, quality reporting, and billing capture (Provation® SurgicalValet™), order set and care plan management (Provation® Order Set Advisor™ and Provation® Care Plans), and EHR embedded clinical documentation (Provation® Clinic Note).

Provation has a loyal customer base, serving more than 5,000 hospitals, surgery centers, and medical offices, and 700 physician groups globally, including 19 of the top 20 U.S. hospitals.

In 2021, Provation was acquired by Fortive Corporation, a Fortune 1000 company that builds essential technology and accelerates transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, engineering, and healthcare. For more information about our solutions, visit provationmedical.com and follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

About CrackaJack Digital Solutions: Since 2016, CrackaJack Digital Solutions has empowered small to mid-sized businesses to thrive through digital transformation. We provide the global expertise needed to navigate today's complex technology landscape. We've evolved beyond traditional IT to become a specialized partner in high-impact security and compliance, with core expertise spanning:
· GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance): Strategic alignment and regulatory mastery
· Identity & Access Management (IAM): Precision control over resource access
· Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing: Proactive defense and vulnerability neutralization
· Data Privacy: Global protection for your most sensitive assets
· Managed IT & Infrastructure: Scalable solutions and technical staffing talent From cloud infrastructure to web development, we deliver practical, data-driven technology tailored to our clients' growth. Mission: To inspire and transform businesses through digital innovations that accelerate long-term, sustainable revenue growth. Vision: To be a global leader in impactful digital IT transformation and cybersecurity excellence. Purpose: Listen & Understand · Lead with Data · Leverage Expertise About the Role: CrackaJack is looking for an Associate Product Manager to support the planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of client digital transformation and security engagements, spanning cloud infrastructure, application development, and GRC/IAM/cybersecurity workstreams. What You'll Do: Delivery & Execution
· Support senior PMs and delivery leads in planning, scoping, and executing client digital transformation projects.
· Translate client requirements into user stories, epics, and technical specifications for engineering teams.
· Maintain and track roadmaps, backlogs, sprints, and delivery timelines across distributed teams.
· Facilitate stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and status updates.
· Identify risks, blockers, and scope changes early, and escalate appropriately.
· Prepare client-facing status reports, project documentation, and presentations. Product Input & Offering Improvement
· Gather and synthesize feedback from clients and delivery teams after engagements, and turn it into concrete recommendations for improving how our GRC, IAM, PenTest, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT offerings are scoped and packaged.
· Contribute to defining offering documentation scope, deliverables, target client profile, and delivery timelines — for at least one or two practice areas.
· Conduct light competitive and market research on how comparable IT/security consultancies package similar services, and bring back actionable input for practice leads.
· Help prioritize a simple backlog of offering and process improvements, working with practice leads across GRC, IAM, PenTest, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT. What We're Looking For:
· 1–3 years of experience in a product management, project coordination, business analyst, or related delivery role (internships and equivalent experience considered).
· Basic understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum preferred).
· Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.
· Clear written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to clients and stakeholders.
· Analytical mindset comfortable doing light market/competitive research and turning client feedback into clear recommendations.
· Ability to work effectively across time zones with distributed, global teams.
· Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have:
· Exposure to GRC, IAM, cybersecurity, or data privacy concepts, or compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, HIPAA, GDPR).
· Experience working with or supporting cloud infrastructure or web/mobile development projects.
· Prior experience in an IT consulting or professional services environment.
· Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Notion, or similar. Why CrackaJack
· Build core PM fundamentals (backlog management, sprint execution, stakeholder communication) while also getting real input into product/offering decisions not just coordination work.
· Direct visibility into and mentorship from company leadership, including our Co-Founder & Managing Director and VP of Global Talent Services.
· Exposure to a broad range of cutting-edge domains: GRC, IAM, penetration testing, data privacy, cloud infrastructure, and AI consulting. Each year we support more than 1 million students, one-third of whom are first-generation, as they apply to our more than 1100 diverse member colleges & universities using the Common App 's free online application.

Mission-driven and passionate about addressing complex problems in college admissions, this person will lead cross-functional teams in identifying, defining, and prioritizing product features that meet the needs of our diverse user base using techniques grounded in an approach to product management and project management.

4-6 years of experience working in or around the college admissions process with a firm understanding of education technology trends and practices.
Demonstrable experience working collaboratively to enhance, build, or launch technology products.
Experience synthesizing research and/or user feedback to identify potential areas for product improvement.
Exceptional problem solving; the ability to identify products and enhancements that add value to constituents and are aligned to project and program goals.
Product vision; the ability to synthesize user needs, market dynamics, and technology advancements to align with product direction.
Analytical acumen; the ability to use data-driven insights to inform decisions and solutions.
Agile or other project management methodology experience with the ability to manage initiatives and lead collaborative groups that span several areas of the organization.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate product and process updates including key milestones, trade-offs, and value considerations to supervisors, teams, and constituents.
An innovative mindset and the ability to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement while leading the product development lifecycle.
Proficient in using collaboration tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Atlassian (e.g., Jira).

Solid understanding of analytical tools, application and admissions data, and/or higher education admissions practices.
Experience in product management or a combination of experience in technology implementation, business analysis, strategy consulting, or related fields.
Experience working collaboratively with user experience and technology teams in solutioning and delivering products and features.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries.
The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide.

In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout.

We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.
As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences.
Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries.
The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide.

In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout.

We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.
As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences.
Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.
Our humble expectations
You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:
Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager
It’s a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts.
Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you’ll own a piece of the pie.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Implement iterative development practices, adjusting priorities and features based on real-time feedback and changing market conditions.

YipitData is making one of its most ambitious Product bets: building an AI-powered product that transforms how clients interact with data. This initiative sits at the center of our product strategy and represents a fundamentally new way for customers to access and derive value from our data.
As a Data Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in making that vision a reality. You will own the path from raw alternative data to trusted, product ready intelligence—determining how complex datasets are structured, interpreted, and ultimately surfaced to customers.
This role sits at the intersection of data, product, and AI. You will work with diverse alternative datasets and develop the methodologies that transform those signals into reliable business insights. You will also serve as a key authority on how the product uses data, helping define what conclusions are methodologically sound, what questions can be answered confidently, and where appropriate guardrails should exist.
Success in this role requires both analytical rigor and a builder's mindset. You'll thrive in ambiguity, tackle problems without established playbooks, and help shape the future of one of YipitData's most strategic products. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of customers interact with our data and how this product scales over time.

Data Source Ownership & Methodology Design
Own the translation of raw alternative datasets into scalable, AIready data products.
Design methodologies that answer high-value business questions, determining how disparate datasets should be combined, normalized, and interpreted.
Partner closely with Data Engineering to shape source data pipelines into clean, well-structured datasets with clear definitions and documentation.
Develop deep expertise in the strengths, limitations, biases, and coverage characteristics of key datasets and ensure those nuances are reflected in downstream outputs.
AI Product Intelligence & Knowledge Systems
Define how the product should use different datasets, including valid query patterns, edge cases, failure modes, and methodological guardrails.
Own metric definitions, data lineage, and documentation to ensure the product consistently delivers accurate and explainable answers.
Establish standards for how the product reasons across multiple datasets, preventing over-interpretation and ensuring conclusions remain statistically defensible.
Serve as the final reviewer for methodology-related changes that impact product behavior.
Product Development & Customer Problem Solving
Translate customer questions into scalable methodologies, data models, and product capabilities.
Expand the range of questions the product can answer by enabling new forms of segmentation, cohort analysis, behavioral measurement, and cross-dataset insights.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to identify new data sources, use cases, and capabilities that increase the commercial value of the AI product.
Help shape the product roadmap by turning emerging customer needs and experimental insights into repeatable product functionality.
Data Quality & Operational Excellence
Coordinate testing and validation of staged data changes before they reach production.
Own incident management processes for data quality issues, methodology changes, and upstream source disruptions.
Build and maintain a library of quality checks tailored to the unique requirements of AI-powered customer experiences.
Ensure the product consistently surfaces reliable, accurate, and internally consistent information across all supported use cases.
You Are Likely to Succeed If You Have
3–6 years of experience in data product management, product analytics, analytics engineering, data science, market intelligence, alternative data, or a closely related field.
Strong fluency in SQL; comfort with data pipelines, schema changes, and upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Experience owning data documentation, metric definitions, or data quality programs—not just conducting ad hoc analysis.
A track record of cross-functional coordination, ideally between technical data teams and product or commercial stakeholders.
Strong project management instincts: you can run a triage process, maintain a quality library, and coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups without dropping balls.
Clear, structured communication—you can translate complex data methodology questions into guidance that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
A demonstrable track record of building—shipping things, solving hard problems, and leaving a clear mark on the products you’ve worked on.
An entrepreneurial mindset: you’re comfortable with ambiguity, energized by new problem spaces, and don’t need a fully paved road to make progress.
Deep experience with alternative data, panel data, or similarly complex, nuanced data sources is required—you need to understand the quirks, limitations, and methodological subtleties of these datasets and be able to encode that understanding for an AI driven product.
Prior experience in or exposure to AI/ML products, LLM-based agents, or evaluation frameworks is a strong plus.

CAS Shield & Apply

About Enroly
At Enroly, we’re transforming the way universities recruit, assess and onboard international students. Our platforms are used by a significant share of UK higher education institutions to streamline compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve the international student experience.

s.h: This role sits across our two core products
s.t:
CAS Shield — our flagship compliance and pre-CAS platform, trusted by nearly half of UK higher education institutions to manage visa readiness, credibility and onboarding at scale.
Apply — our application and admissions product, where institutions, agents and applicants come together at the very start of the student journey.
Enroly was recently acquired by Ecctis, the UK’s leading authority on international qualifications and skills benchmarking. Ecctis delivers essential services including qualification evaluation, recognition frameworks, and global consulting to governments, education providers, and employers. Together, we’re building a future-proofed approach to student recruitment and enrolment, backed by unparalleled data, insight, and capability.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Interviews and Interview Assessment across CAS Shield and Apply.
This is not a backlog-management role. You will be expected to define the product direction, make strategic trade-offs and establish how interviewing and assessment should work across Enroly's products.
Interviewing is one of the highest-stakes moments in the international student journey. Institutions use it to establish credibility, assess English language ability, and make admissions and compliance decisions that carry real regulatory weight. Applicants experience it on a mobile phone, often on a poor connection, in a different time zone, and frequently as their first direct interaction with the university.
Your job is to make that experience work — fair, credible, defensible and genuinely usable at scale. You’ll own the roadmap for asynchronous and live interviewing, assessment and scoring, and the integrity and proctoring capabilities that sit around them. This is a build-and-scale role: parts of this space are new, and you’ll be shaping direction as much as delivering against it.
This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can balance applicant experience against institutional and regulatory needs, and is excited to define a product area rather than inherit one.

Own and drive the product roadmap for Interviews and Interview Assessment across both CAS Shield and Apply, aligned with Enroly’s company strategy.
Define the interviewing model: asynchronous and live formats, question design and banks, scoring rubrics, reviewer workflows, and assessment outputs institutions can act on and defend.
Own integrity and proctoring: identity verification, fraud and impersonation signals, AI-assisted detection, and the balance between assurance and a humane applicant experience.
Lead the mobile-first applicant experience — video capture, low-bandwidth resilience, accessibility, and drop-off reduction across devices and geographies.
Make the case for AI where it genuinely helps — transcription, summarisation, scoring support, anomaly detection — while keeping humans accountable for decisions.
Ensure interviews and assessment work coherently across two products, with a consistent experience for applicants and clear ownership boundaries internally.
Work directly with university admissions and compliance teams, agents, applicants and internal stakeholders to understand how interviews are created, completed, reviewed and used in admissions and compliance decisions.
Lead product discovery —Conduct discovery across the full interview lifecycle, including interview creation, applicant completion, assessment, reviewer workflows and institutional decision-making.
Work day-to-day with a dedicated squad: writing and refining user stories, managing backlogs, setting acceptance criteria, and collaborating closely with developers and QA.
Prioritise and execute improvements, from bug triage and fixes to new feature delivery, based on business impact and user feedback.
Post-launch analysis: track usage, completion and assessment quality, gather feedback, and use data to continuously iterate.
Champion compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g. UKVI credibility expectations, data protection, auditability) in product decisions and design.
Be the internal advocate for interviewing at Enroly, aligning teams around shared goals and user outcomes.
What Success Looks Like
High applicant completion rates and a demonstrably better interview experience, particularly on mobile.
Institutions trust the assessment output enough to make decisions on it — and can defend those decisions.
Interview integrity is measurably strong, with fraud and impersonation risk reduced without punishing genuine applicants.
Meaningful reduction in manual reviewer effort per interview.
Interviewing works as one coherent capability across CAS Shield and Apply.
Efficient prioritisation and execution of improvements and fixes.
Alignment with wider business and regulatory goals.
Who You’ll Work With
Product team: PMs, Designers, Solutions, Integrations
Tech team: Developers, QA — including mobile and AI/ML capability
Wider Enroly teams: Customer Success Managers, Compliance, Services, Marketing
Clients: university admissions and compliance teams, agent partners, and applicants
Challenges You’ll Tackle
Building a high-stakes, high-scrutiny product area where getting it wrong has real consequences for applicants and institutions.
Balancing integrity and assurance against applicant experience and completion.
Delivering a reliable video and mobile experience across highly variable devices, networks and geographies.
Serving two products with different lifecycles, users and delivery rhythms.
Working in an environment with limited resources and many competing voices.
Balancing short-term fixes with strategic improvements.
Navigating complex stakeholder landscapes in the education sector.
A growing team, evolving processes, and a high bar for quality.

Essential
3–4 years of experience in B2B SaaS product management.
Hands-on product experience in at least one of: asynchronous or video interviewing, remote proctoring or online assessment, identity verification, or another integrity-critical product area.
Experience delivering mobile or mobile-web products, with a real understanding of the constraints — device fragmentation, media capture, bandwidth, permissions, accessibility.
Strong execution skills: product discovery, prioritisation, delivery.
Fluency with qualitative and quantitative data.
Confident in internal and external stakeholder management, with strong communication and presentation skills.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Orchestrator, Chili Piper's GTM Control Layer.
Internally, we think of this role as a Product Market Fitter. This is not a traditional roadmap management role. It is a product leadership role for someone who loves building complex, enterprise-grade products and has the judgment to turn customer and market evidence into focused product bets that drive real adoption and business impact.
Orchestrator listens for signals across Chili Piper and external tools, decides what should happen next, and takes the action itself. That includes catching a form abandonment, a no-show, a missed meeting, or a cold chat, checking ICP fit, account ownership, intent history, and CRM state, then firing the right next step: enrolling a sequence in Salesloft, Outreach, or Gong Engage, notifying a rep, rescheduling a meeting, or sending a booking link.
You will own the full arc of a product bet: target customer, first audience, market and customer evidence, problem definition, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, success metrics, first adoption trigger, usage learning, and business outcome.
You will own the solution concept, meaning what we offer and how it is offered. You will not own solution architecture, implementation, or product enablement execution. You will partner closely with a Product Designer and a Product Engineering Lead to shape solutions that are valuable, coherent, and practical to deliver.
This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn complex workflows, data, and customer needs into clear product direction. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to build products that solve real problems for sophisticated users and who measures success by whether customers actually adopt what gets built.

Own Orchestrator end to end, from market and customer evidence through adoption, iteration, and long-term business impact
Define the first audience for every bet and protect that focus as new requests, edge cases, and opportunities emerge
Identify the right problems to solve and turn signal detection, decisioning, and action-taking into clear product direction
Define value, viability, priority, and success metrics, including what should trigger first adoption
Monitor adoption and real usage after launch, then use what you learn to improve the product and shape what comes next
Keep signal types, decision logic, and external integrations coherent, so the system stays predictable and trustworthy as it grows

Who this role is for
This role is best suited to someone energized by high ownership, independent judgment, and making decisions without a playbook. We give people real responsibility and a lot of room to operate, which means you will be expected to run your area, set direction, and make hard calls with imperfect information.
If you are looking for a highly directed environment with a lot of structure around what to do next, this is probably not the right fit.
How this role works
We care deeply about clear ownership and close cross-functional partnership.
The Product Market Fitter owns the target customer, problem, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, adoption, and business result
The Product Designer owns the experience and product-side enablement
The Product Designer and Product Engineering Lead jointly own solution architecture
The Product Engineering Lead owns the technical solution and delivery execution

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.
We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.
As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value.

Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.
If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.
Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.
Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.
Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.
Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.
What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.
Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.
Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.
Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.
High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.
Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.
Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.
Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.
Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager, API Integrations who is based in SEA to join our Supply domain , more specifically in the Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems, harmonizing data structures and building revenue-increasing products for carriers). This is key to scale our business, therefore our focus is on innovation and automation.

Extend functionalities to enable new opportunities.
Automate and innovate our existing inventory (our API product is already used by big players).
Own scoping and management of onboarding new carriers; establish wider scope throughout Asia.
Take a lead role in defining and challenging strategic decisions.
Contribute to the team with process improvements (e.g. Jira, reporting etc.).
Build relationships with key stakeholders (internal/external – C-level).
We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe.

3+ years or more of professional experience in Product Management.
Hands-on experience with the technical side of the product (API / Data products).
Strong stakeholder experience within with ability to influence without direct authority (including C-level executives).
Good at context switching whilst showing proactivity and ownership across your responsibilities.
Experience working with complex products (advantage).
Good management skills (product, process, project, people management).
Experience working within cross-functional teams.
Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related studies.
Fluent in English, both verbal and written.

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.
You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!
We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

Own the advertising product roadmap end to end — from ad format and placement strategy through serving infrastructure, targeting, measurement, and reporting.
Design and launch native, integrated ad experiences in partnership with Product Design. Our thesis is that ads on TeamSnap should feel like part of the product and drive value for both our consumer users and advertisers.
Own the serving and targeting stack: ad server implementation, trafficking and campaign delivery workflows, private marketplace deal setup, and the first-party signal work that makes our inventory worth buying — getting the right context to the ad call so it can be used for targeting.
Build the measurement foundation: impression and viewability tracking, event instrumentation, third-party verification where advertisers require it, advertiser-facing reporting, and the experimentation framework to improve placements and creative over time.
Own ad quality, density, and user experience standards — where ads appear, how often, and what we won't do.
Partner with Ad Sales and Revenue Operations to turn product capability into sellable inventory — packaging, the targeting taxonomy they sell against, rate card inputs, and campaign delivery and pacing.
Model and forecast the business. Build the volume, fill rate, and eCPM models that tell us which placements are worth building, and what has to be true for a given format to pay for itself.
Own privacy and compliance requirements for ad targeting and data use, in partnership with Legal — including how children's data is treated, given the families we serve.
Work in ambiguity. Break down an undefined space into a sequenced plan, make practical tradeoffs between revenue, engineering cost, and user impact, and bring partners along with a clear point of view.

7-10 years in product management, with meaningful time spent on the publisher/supply side of the ads ecosystem — building and monetizing ad inventory inside a consumer product.

Deep, hands-on technical fluency with the publisher ad stack: ad server implementation and trafficking (Google Ad Manager or equivalent), programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace deals, key-value and audience targeting, ad SDK integration, VAST and video formats. Command of the economics: fill rate, eCPM, RPM, sell-through, viewability, latency, and how each moves in response to product decisions. Comfortable pricing inventory without an auction to tell you what it's worth. You can build the model yourself and defend the assumptions.
Experience working alongside a direct ad sales organization — translating between what sales wants to sell and what the product can actually deliver, and building the packaging that closes the gap.

Experience with rewarded video, pre-roll, or other video monetization formats.
Background in a subscription business where advertising had to coexist with a paid tier without cannibalizing it.

Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

s.h: AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI
s.t:
BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.
As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass , while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.
The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass .

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role.

You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds.

Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you
accordingly.

Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.

· Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.

· Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.

· Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.

· Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.

· Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.

· Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.

· Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.

· Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.

· A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.

· Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.

· Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.

· A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.

· Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.

· Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, Anwenderinnen und Anwendern sowie Entwicklungspartnern gestaltest du digitale Produkte und Services, die echten Mehrwert schaffen und den Schweizer Sport nachhaltig weiterentwickeln.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Bereichs Digitalisierung \& Innovation suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als **Senior Product Owner (80\-100%)**.
**Das kannst du bewegen**
* Du verantwortest Vision, Strategie und Roadmap deiner Produkte und Services und stellst deren Ausrichtung an den Zielen von Swiss Olympic und den Bedürfnissen der Anspruchsgruppen sicher.
* Du steuerst den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus – von der Konzeption über die Einführung und den Betrieb bis zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung oder Ablösung.
* Du identifizierst und priorisierst Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, Anwender\*innen, Mitgliedsverbänden und weiteren Partnern.
* Du führst interdisziplinäre Product Teams fachlich und koordinierst Weiterentwicklungen unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Qualität, Kosten, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Terminen.
* Du stellst einen stabilen und bedarfsgerechten Betrieb deiner Produkte und Services sicher und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Supportorganisationen, Lieferanten und externen Entwicklungspartnern.
* Du erkennst Potenziale in den Bereichen Digitalisierung, Innovation und künstliche Intelligenz und überführst sie dort, wo sie einen konkreten Nutzen schaffen, in deine Produkte und Services.
**Das bringst du mit**
* Du hast eine höhere Fachausbildung oder einen Hochschulabschluss (FH/Uni) in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung digitaler Produkte und Services sowie mit Standard\- und Eigenentwicklungen mit.
* Du kennst dich mit agilen und klassischen Projektmanagementmethoden.
* Du überzeugst durch Kommunikations\- und Moderationsstärke und führst interdisziplinäre Teams sicher und verbindlich.
* Du arbeitest selbständig, strukturiert, verantwortungsbewusst und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld den Überblick.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute ösischkenntnisse – oder umgekehrt – und gute Englischkenntnisse.
**Dein Arbeitsplatz**
Wir bieten dir eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit im Sportumfeld. Dein Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Ittigen bei Bern, Homeoffice ist teilweise möglich. Wir pflegen eine offene, wertschätzende und sportliche Arbeitskultur und bieten Raum für Eigenverantwortung und Mitgestaltung.
**Bist du interessiert?**
Dann sende uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen **bis spätestens Mittwoch, 14\. Oktober 2026**. Für Fragen zur Stelle steht dir Pettersson, Leiterin Abteilung Digitalisierung und Innovation, unter der Telefonnummer gerne zur Verfügung.
Wir glauben an die Stärke der Vielfalt und möchten sicherstellen, dass unser Team die unterschiedlichsten Hintergründe und Perspektiven repräsentiert. Wir ermutigen daher alle Interessierten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, , sexueller Orientierung oder Weltanschauung, sich bei uns zu bewerben. Bei uns zählen Friendship, Respect, Excellence und der Wunsch, gemeinsam zu wachsen und zu lernen.

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges.

But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.
Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager with a background in science or engineering and quantum computing or HPC experience to help define and grow an important part of Riverlane’s software product portfolio.
This is an early-stage, fast-moving area of our product roadmap: you’ll help shape its direction as much as run what already exists.
You’ll sit right at the heart of this product area, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. You’ll use a blend of user insight, product data and market context to cut through complexity and focus on what matters most.
You’ll own and evolve the strategy and roadmap, bringing together engineering, research, business development and marketing around a shared vision, striking the balance between bold, long-term ambition and what’s realistically achievable today.
This role sits close to the centre of Riverlane, working daily with colleagues across Engineering, Science and the PMO. We ask for three days a week in our Cambridge office to make that collaboration easy.
This role involves quarterly travel, less than 10% of your time, to conferences such as IEEE and to visit customers.

Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, stakeholder input and Riverlane’s strategic direction
Engage with customers, partners and internal teams to build a complete picture of market needs and the competitive landscape
Use product usage data, market insight and competitive analysis to prioritise features and drive adoption
Align stakeholders across the C-suite, research, engineering, business development and marketing, and identify new market opportunities for Riverlane
Support go-to-market execution and launch readiness with Marketing and Business Development, including external collateral and documentation
Monitor delivery progress and adapt plans as new challenges or opportunities emerge
What we need
A background in engineering or science (degree or equivalent experience)
4+ years in B2B product management
Experience in a HPC or quantum computing, translating complex technical trade-offs into product decisions
High emotional intelligence, with strong active listening and critical thinking skills
A collaborative, cross-functional team player who can influence without authority and build trust across teams
Ease with going technically deep, both internally and externally, to understand product capabilities and limitations
Someone who thrives in a fast-moving, ambiguous and rapidly evolving environment
Excellent communication, presentation and documentation skills, with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences
A proactive mindset: you spot opportunities for improvement and act on them independently
Willingness to travel occasionally (roughly quarterly, under 10% of your time) for conferences and customer visits
Even better if you have…
You have experience with both hardware and software product management

What can you expect from us
A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, and a contributory pension scheme
Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Riverlane
28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave
A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities
A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets

Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information-and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the \"messy\" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you won't just manage a roadmap; you will build 0-to-1 platforms that bridge the digital and physical worlds. You'll need to lead through influence, not control, and stay resilient while balancing the needs of external partners, engineering teams, and global business units. If you are a curious, owner-minded product leader who is energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact-this is where you'll grow.

Build a bold product vision and strategy for your domain, identifying near and long-term initiatives that unlock the next wave of Uber's global growth.
Design and ship scalable technology solutions-including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools-to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals.
Navigate and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities.
Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes.
Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations.
Iterate relentlessly by distilling insights from performance dashboards, experimentation results, and user research to continuously raise the bar for quality and reliability.

6 + years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale projects each quarter that yield quantifiable impact.
Proven ability to convert unstructured problems with significant ambiguity into clarifying, focused plans for multi-team projects.
Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery.
Demonstrated leadership in overseeing deeply experimental teams, partnering with data science managers to drive strong experimentation and data-driven prioritization.
Proficient in UX/UI paradigms: Ability to own the design process for complex products, providing deep context to designers while driving fast iteration cycles for new concepts.
Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support.
Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.

Domain expertise in Financial Services, Autonomous Vehicles, or high-scale Marketplace mechanics.
Passionate about shipping \"magical,\" defect-free products, overseeing quality monitoring, alerting, and retrospective processes.
Proven recruiter and mentor: Ability to successfully hire for the team and serve as a coveted member of all product interview loops.
Strategic 0-to-1 experience: Generating innovative ideas for new product areas and incorporating customer feedback into long-term visions.
Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.

In dieser Position übernehmen Sie Verantwortung, arbeiten interdisziplinär und international und wirken aktiv an der Zukunft industrieller Wärmetechnologie mit.
## Deine Aufgaben ##
* Marktpotenziale und Trends erkennen und in Produktimpulse übersetzen
* Produkt-Roadmap entwickeln und neue Anwendungen/Märkte erschliessen
* Globales Portfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus steuern (Idee - Entwicklung - Launch)
* Anforderungen definieren, priorisieren und technische/kommerzielle Themen koordinieren
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit R&D, Sales, Business Development und Marketing
* Internationale Teams/Kunden bei Anwendungen und Einführungen unterstützen
* Wettbewerbsanalysen durchführen und relevante Trends ableiten
* Produktbotschaften sowie Schulungsunterlagen erstellen
* Kunden-, Partner- und Messebesuche weltweit (ca. 10-20% Reisen)

* Studium im Engineering (HF/FH/ETH o. ä.)
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder industriellen Umfeld
* Sehr gutes Verständnis für Märkte, Anwendungen und Technologietrends
* Kommunikationsstark, überzeugend, sicheres Auftreten
* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
* Freude an interdisziplinärer und internationaler Zusammenarbeit
## Was dich erwartet ##
* spannende Tätigkeit in einem marktführenden, internationalen Unternehmen im Kanton Obwalden
* wir sind von einer grossartigen Berglandschaft mit attraktiven Freizeitmöglichkeiten umgeben
* flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und bis zu zwei Tagen Home-Office - wo möglich und sinnvoll
* sehr gute Unterstützung bei neuen und innovativen Ideen
* Unterstützung bei der Weiterbildung und Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung
* Betriebskantine in Kägiswil und frische Verpflegungsmöglichkeiten in Sarnen, attraktive Benefits, kostenlose Parkplätze inklusive E-Tankstellen, Duschen für Sportler/innen
